name: RAG-Bench-TextbookQA
description: RAG-Bench-TextbookQA evaluates retrieval-augmented question answering on textbook-style questions: models must retrieve relevant textbook passages and produce correct answers. It measures how well RAG-style systems combine retrieval and generation to solve educational/multi-step problems grounded in textbook content.
evaluation_method: accuracy (exact / best-answer match against reference answers)
reputation: A research-focused dataset for evaluating RAG systems on textbook QA; modest adoption within retrieval-augmented generation research.
